entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I leave behind a legacy that is im..."
entries.dialogueText: "I leave behind a legacy that is imperfect, yet mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""History will judge my years on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "History will judge my years on the throne. But I pray it judges them fairly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No throne can stand untouched in a..."
entries.dialogueText: "No throne can stand untouched in a storm. And in recent years, the storm has not passed over us. It has passed through us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Somewhere along the way, something..."
entries.dialogueText: "Somewhere along the way, something broke between the Crown and the people. And though I tried to hold it together, I fear my hands weren't enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But you must know that I fought fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you must know that I fought for you. I fought for the reforms. I stood before the nobility and made the case myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Revolutions do not wait politely...."
entries.dialogueText: "Revolutions do not wait politely. They arrive loudly, and often, without mercy. And the first person they come for is the king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I chose not to answer rebellion wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I chose not to answer rebellion with violence, because I still believed there was another way. Perhaps that was weakness. Perhaps it was wisdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The people demanded change -- and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people demanded change -- and they did not ask for it gently. I heard them. But I did not always know how to answer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I chose this. I opened the ga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I chose this. I opened the gates. I invited them in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believed that if anyone should e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believed that if anyone should end the old order, it ought to be someone within it -- someone who could do it without bloodshed. So I made a pact. We struck before they could."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not to save myself. But to save Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to save myself. But to save Rizia from the devastation of a civil war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not pretend it was a celebr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not pretend it was a celebration. What occurred behind those doors changed the course of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My actions cannot be called surren..."
entries.dialogueText: "My actions cannot be called surrender. It was a safeguard. An act to avoid the bloodshed history has witnessed too many times before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew the risks. But I saw someth..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew the risks. But I saw something in their cause --something that resonated louder than our titles ever did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must tell you -- just as I was b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must tell you -- just as I was betrayed, so too was the reform movement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This was not the reform I imagined..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was not the reform I imagined. I sought a constitutional kingdom. They sought a reckoning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They came in fast, rifles pointed...."
entries.dialogueText: "They came in fast, rifles pointed. In seconds, we were all under their control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Instead of staying true to their v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Instead of staying true to their vision, the reformers opened their doors to radicals -- and in doing so, betrayed your faith in them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have chosen to step down -- not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have chosen to step down -- not out of weakness, but out of strength. The strength to know when to let go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am relinquishing the throne with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am relinquishing the throne with a heavy heart, but with a clear conscience."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby announce my abdication. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby announce my abdication. Because the future demands it. Because holding power too tightly can choke the very life of a nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I speak to you now in full honesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I speak to you now in full honesty, as a king who has been forced to abdicate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Many of you may be wondering what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many of you may be wondering what transpired during my mother's birthday at the Grand Library..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've heard whispers of the birth..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've heard whispers of the birthday that became a battlefield. Let me assure you: nothing about it was accidental."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will hear many versions of wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will hear many versions of what happened inside the Grand Library that evening. I only ask that you remember -- not everything is always what it seems."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The heads of noble houses gathered..."
entries.dialogueText: "The heads of noble houses gathered, and I brought them there. What followed was what had to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When the doors closed and the revo..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the doors closed and the revolutionaries entered, I knew that our long era of peace under the monarchy was over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is true. I myself invited the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true. I myself invited the revolutionaries inside. I worked with them to stop the nobility from usurping the will of the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My innocent, elderly mother and I..."
entries.dialogueText: "My innocent, elderly mother and I sat together that day -- completely unaware, like many of you, of what was coming."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo and the revolutionary guards..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo and the revolutionary guards exchanged uneasy glances.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries' eyes sharpened..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries' eyes sharpened. No one said anything, but the warning was clear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believed I was guiding a transit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believed I was guiding a transition. Instead, I inadvertently lit a fuse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What began as cooperation ended as..."
entries.dialogueText: "What began as cooperation ended as a coup. The pen I offered them was snatched and turned into a blade."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All I ever wanted was to help brin..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I ever wanted was to help bring the reform movement's vision to life -- to see the Rizian Charter of Rights become law."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries said nothing, b..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries said nothing, but their gaze made their disproval plain.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The people demanded change -- and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people demanded change -- and they did not ask for it gently. But I finally I heard them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And, I made a choice -- a choice t..."
entries.dialogueText: "And, I made a choice -- a choice to relinquish my power to the people of Rizia, by whatever means necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because what began as murmurs in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because what began as murmurs in the streets became something no gun, no decree, no palace could silence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This was not the transition I imag..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was not the transition I imagined. I sought a peaceful political changeover. They sought a reckoning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The upper echelons of Rizian nobil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The upper echelons of Rizian nobility were devising a sick plan to undermine the will of the Rizian people. With the help of Adarfo Sotelato, we foiled their scheme."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo nodded approvingly and smile..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo nodded approvingly and smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo looked at me with surprise a..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo looked at me with surprise and then smiled, nodding approvingly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But this was not the transition I..."
entries.dialogueText: "But this was not the transition I imagined. I sought smooth political changes. He sought a reckoning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On that day, I listened to a movem..."
entries.dialogueText: "On that day, I listened to a movement that spoke with the voice of the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His smile quickly turned into a fro..."
entries.dialogueText: His smile quickly turned into a frown.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And today, there are no longer any..."
entries.dialogueText: "And today, there are no longer any obstacles left before the Rizian people. The road has been cleared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But this was not the transition I..."
entries.dialogueText: "But this was not the transition I imagined. I sought a peaceful political changeover. They sought a reckoning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries started applaud..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries started applauding.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What went wrong? That answer depen..."
entries.dialogueText: "What went wrong? That answer depends on who you ask. But I know this: the surest way to foster discontent is to ignore it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There were those who believed I ga..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were those who believed I gave too much. Others said I gave too little. Perhaps the truth lies somewhere in between -- but the result is here, before us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I became the villain in someone el..."
entries.dialogueText: "I became the villain in someone else's story -- the scapegoat for the chaos no one dared to own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I could turn back time, there a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I could turn back time, there are things I would do differently. Of that, I have no doubt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps I tried too hard to preser..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps I tried too hard to preserve something that no longer wished to be preserved. And for that... I am sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A man named Adarfo Sotelato now sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "A man named Adarfo Sotelato now speaks for you. And whether you agree with his methods or not, you cannot deny that he has been heard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The revolutionary leaders now spea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The revolutionary leaders now speak for you. And whether you agree with their methods or not, you cannot deny that they have been heard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There were incidents I could not c..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were incidents I could not control, yet I bore the full weight of their consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In times of unrest, people do not..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of unrest, people do not look for truth -- they look for someone to blame. And I stood at the center."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I stand by every single decision I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand by every single decision I made during my reign as King. I wouldn't change a thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But the truth is, I did not deserv..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the truth is, I did not deserve any of this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This revolution did not rise from..."
entries.dialogueText: "This revolution did not rise from within alone. It was fed -- funded -- by those across the border, by Morella and its shadowy backers in the CSP."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may say I was weak for not fig..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may say I was weak for not fighting back. I say I was strong for refusing to answer their calls for civil war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The streets spoke louder than the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The streets spoke louder than the throne. And in time, I was forced to listen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My only regret is that I allowed a..."
entries.dialogueText: "My only regret is that I allowed a group of agitators to sway the masses into violence -- violence against Rizia, its people, and its very traditions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not stand here to deflect bla..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not stand here to deflect blame. I stand here to carry it, as a king must."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not seek this end. I was mad..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not seek this end. I was made the face of our nation's problems -- whether I caused them or not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I supported the reforms. I present..."
entries.dialogueText: "I supported the reforms. I presented them to the very people who now claim I stood in their way. They refused. And I was made to look like the obstructor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We gave them everything they could..."
entries.dialogueText: "We gave them everything they could have asked for. But nothing was enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My only regret is failing to give..."
entries.dialogueText: "My only regret is failing to give the Rizian people what they hoped for -- what they deserved."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries were getting re..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries were getting restless. Their gaze sharpened.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When the royal houses turned their..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the royal houses turned their backs, what power did I have to force their cooperation?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't say I did nothing. I carried..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't say I did nothing. I carried your proposals into the lion's den -- and I was torn apart for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Although it wasn't my wish for thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although it wasn't my wish for things to come to this, I must salute the Rizian People's Party and the reform movement. You finally won!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo flinched at the word “forced..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo flinched at the word “forced.” He stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A revolutionary flinched at the wor..."
entries.dialogueText: A revolutionary flinched at the word “forced.” She stepped closer to me, hand resting just near her holster.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo immediately stepped closer t..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo immediately stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""That wasn't part of the speech, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "That wasn't part of the speech, Mr. Toras. Stick to the statement. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo leaned in and whispered."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo leaned in and whispered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo quickly stepped closer to me..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo quickly stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A revolutionary quickly stepped clo..."
entries.dialogueText: A revolutionary quickly stepped closer tome, hand resting just near her holster.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Cut it. That's enough!""
entries.dialogueText: "Cut it. That's enough!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A revolutionary shouted: "Cut it. T..."
entries.dialogueText: A revolutionary shouted: "Cut it. That's enough!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You heard me right! The reform mov..."
entries.dialogueText: "You heard me right! The reform movement was hijacked by extre--"
entries.menuText: "You heard me right! The reform movement was hijacked by extremist factions -- by people who do not plan to follow the will of the Rizian people but to force their own values upon you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And as a result, I'm making a choi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And as a result, I'm making a choice today to relinquish all my powers to the people. I truly believe this is the best way forward for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What I'm doing is not surrender. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I'm doing is not surrender. It is deliberate. An act to avoid the bloodshed history has written too many times before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are those who marched at his..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are those who marched at his side, and those who cursed his name. I stood between them, trying to make sense of it all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He has seized the moment, and is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has seized the moment, and is poised to fulfill the hopes -- or greatest fears -- of a nation in flux. I leave it to history to decide which."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are those who marched at the..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are those who marched at their side, and those who cursed their names. And I stood between them, trying to make sense of it all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They have seized the moment, and a..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have seized the moment, and are poised to fulfill the hopes -- or greatest fears -- of a nation in flux. I leave it to history to decide which."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the noblemen and -women who onc..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the noblemen and -women who once ruled with me: you saw change as a threat, and refused to see the future knocking at your door. Perhaps if we had changed together, this wouldn't have ended as it did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To my fellow Rizians, I say: even..."
entries.dialogueText: "To my fellow Rizians, I say: even in dissent -- even in rage -- you remained the beating heart of this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I say to the revolutionaries: You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I say to the revolutionaries: You are in control already, you've won. Lay down your arms and let the people organize their own government without the influence of a single faction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe his movement will rise t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe his movement will rise to this responsibility and build a government that serves all of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe this movement will rise..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe this movement will rise to this responsibility and build a government that serves all of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo quickly stepped closer to me..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo quickly stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A revolutionary quickly stepped clo..."
entries.dialogueText: A revolutionary quickly stepped closer tome, hand resting just near her holster.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We cannot rewrite the past. So we..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot rewrite the past. So we should not dwell on it any longer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries pointed to the..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries pointed to the clock. It was time to finish my speech.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless, I believe Mr. Sotelato..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, I believe Mr. Sotelato and his movement will rise to the responsibility they have taken on -- and build a government that serves all of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, I'd like to ask everyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I'd like to ask everyone to give their full support to the new government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It is with a heart heavy with emoti..."
entries.dialogueText: It is with a heart heavy with emotion, yet buoyed by hope for our future, I now declare my official abdication from the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To put it plainly, I am finished...."
entries.dialogueText: "To put it plainly, I am finished. Done. Outta here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From henceforth, I am stepping dow..."
entries.dialogueText: "From henceforth, I am stepping down in order to give way to the new order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It gives me no great pleasure to r..."
entries.dialogueText: "It gives me no great pleasure to relinquish my crown. Yet I know in my heart it is what I must do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries pointed to the..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries pointed to the clock. It was time to finish my speech.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I feel that I have done my part fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel that I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Throughout my reign, I have been u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Throughout my reign, I have been uplifted and sustained by the knowledge that your thoughts and prayers were with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They didn't come to negotiate -- t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They didn't come to negotiate -- they came to seize."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew there was no point in fight..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew there was no point in fighting back."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo immediately stepped closer t..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo immediately stepped closer to me, his hand resting just near his holster.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""That wasn't part of the speech, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "That wasn't part of the speech, Mr. Toras. Stick to the statement. Don't provoke the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo leaned in and whispered."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo leaned in and whispered.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""That wasn't part of the speech, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "That wasn't part of the speech, Mr. Toras..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""This is your last warning, Toras...."
entries.dialogueText: "This is your last warning, Toras. Think very carefully about your next words."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionary guards exchanged..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionary guards exchanged uneasy glances.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But none of this changes the fact..."
entries.dialogueText: "But none of this changes the fact that, today, I am making this announcement at gunp--"
entries.menuText: "But none of this changes the fact that, today, I am making this announcement at gunpoint."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They took my wife away from me --..."
entries.dialogueText: "They took my wife away from me -- in co-"
entries.menuText: "They took my wife away from me -- in cold blood!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They executed General Taddeus and..."
entries.dialogueText: "They executed General Taddeus and his daughter witho-"
entries.menuText: "They executed General Taddeus and his daughter without a shred of mercy. Not a trial. Not a question. Just bullets."

entries.title: Player_Romus: "“What began as cooperation ended as..."
entries.dialogueText: “What began as cooperation ended as a coup. I offered the olive branch. They turned it into a sword. Perhaps they were never guided by the light.”

entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Yes, I chose this path. But perhap..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, I chose this path. But perhaps it was laid before me by divine design.”
